title: Eid
summary: Eid al-Fitr marks the end of Ramadan fasting; Eid al-Adha commemorates Ibrahim's devotion. Both are celebrated with prayers, new clothes, family meals and charity; in Bengal, festive dishes like biryani and shemai are popular.
